title: 第7章 这一夜王生成长了第8章 测试野望斗拳场
content_zh:
“呼，呼呼......”
王生喘着粗气睁开了眼，看了下桌上钟表的时间，此刻已是将近晚上十点。
“痛痛痛......”
明明已经复活刷新了状态，可那股疼痛仿佛刻在灵魂里，让他这副健康身躯产生了不明原因的幻痛。
“我发誓这辈子......不，哪怕投胎一万次，我也不愿意再以这种方式死一次。”
彻骨的疼痛几乎是在摧残精神，他下次如果真能再复刻一次这种死亡方式，说不定精神力与意志力也会被增幅。
因为他到死之前肯定会疯掉。
“绝不能再这么搞了......而且随着我越来越强，把自己‘练死’需要付出的努力也越来越恐怖，这回是两小时折磨，下回不得四五个小时么？”
当然，这还是最为理想的预测。
王生更怀疑，他再复刻这招时，特性会主动激活类似“宕机保护”之类的防练死机制。
“这也就是说，比起自己摧残自己，我更应该主动涉险，被人或者怪物什么的杀死，这才是更适合的变强途径。”
思及至此，王生便也打消了复刻修炼致死途径的念头。
还是得上裂隙战场啊。
不，那有点遥远了，往近的说，地下黑拳、高中历练任务更靠谱一些。
“看来这个金手指可开发的方向还很多，今天就到这里吧，当务之急......”
应该是验收一下努力的成果。
思及至此，王生摆好架势，运转起《原始炼体法》中的桩功和呼吸法。
才刚一上手，他就很快发现了这功法的与众不同。
这门炼体之法古朴、厚重，带着一种拙与钝，和自己以往修炼的功法很不一样。
王生原本修炼的《第十三套中学生基础修炼法》，固然是最适宜普罗大众、极为方便打底子的普适性修炼法门。

但普适性却意味着失了特色，没有因材施教难免扼杀个体优势，算是全民高武下存在取舍的产物。
只有一些大家名门，才会在修炼之初放弃该功法，特意找私人教练另修他门。
再将话头说回《原始炼体法》。
王生感觉这门功法的确很适合他。
没有花里胡哨，也没有为了后续适应其他功法，而去打所谓的底子，只是很纯粹地在提升身体基本素质，并且做得十分极致。
“原始炼体法分为五篇：呼吸、炼体、桩功、淬身、战意。”
他一边站桩运功，一边复盘着脑海里多出的记忆。
“其中战意需要入境方能修习，淬身需要药材......我没钱，现在专心修习前三篇为佳。”
想着，他开始缓缓打起了动作。
一小时后。
“呼，几个周天下来，似乎快要功法入门了，这就是上品凡骨么？”
修行速度完全不可同日而语，比预想的翻两三倍还要强得多。
“如今我虽未入境，可身体素质已经达到了铜骨境初段武者的水平，还差的便是气血了。”
气血，一名武者的精气神皆在此体现，庞大的气血是强者的标识与名片。
一个人若只是身体硬朗，但气血虚弱，那就像是名身子坚硬的病人，感受上很奇怪。
总之，必须在三个月内将气血值提升到1点。
尽管距离1点气血值还有足足0.2的距离，但王生已经有信心在三个月后的武考中，抵达这个水平。
只要再借此冲入铜骨境初段，那么青江一中就很有希望。
“但不够保险。”
入段是保送门槛没错，可不代表稳上，更不代表只要考试就能录取。

所以还得再强一些！
content_en:
"Huh, huhu..."
Wang Sheng gasped and opened his eyes, and looked at the time on the clock on the table. It was almost ten o'clock in the evening.
"It hurts, it hurts..."
He had obviously been resurrected and refreshed his status, but the pain seemed to be engraved in his soul, causing his healthy body to suffer from unexplained phantom pain.
"I swear that in this life... no, even if I am reincarnated ten thousand times, I am not willing to die in this way again."
The bone-piercing pain is almost destroying the spirit. If he can repeat this way of death next time, maybe his mental power and willpower will also be increased.
Because he will definitely go crazy before he dies.
"I must never do this again...and as I get stronger and stronger, the effort required to 'train myself to death' becomes more and more terrifying. This time it was two hours of torture, but next time it won't be four or five hours?"
Of course, this is still the most ideal prediction.
Wang Sheng even suspected that when he reproduced this move, the feature would actively activate an anti-training mechanism like "downtime protection".
"This means that instead of destroying myself, I should take the initiative to take risks and be killed by people or monsters. This is a more suitable way to become stronger."
Thinking of this, Wang Sheng gave up the idea of practicing the path to death again.
You still have to go to the Rift Battlefield.
No, that's a bit far away. To put it more closely, underground black boxing and high school experience missions are more reliable.
"It seems that there are still many directions for development of this golden finger. Let's stop here today. The top priority..."
It should be about accepting the results of your efforts.
Thinking of this, Wang Sheng got into position and started using the pile exercises and breathing methods in the "Original Body Training Method".
As soon as he got started, he quickly discovered how unique this technique was.
This body-training method is simple and heavy, with a kind of clumsiness and bluntness, which is very different from the methods I have practiced in the past.
The "Thirteenth Basic Cultivation Method for Middle School Students" originally practiced by Wang Sheng is certainly a universal cultivation method that is most suitable for the general public and is extremely convenient for laying the foundation.
However, universality means that it loses its characteristics. Failure to teach students in accordance with their aptitude will inevitably stifle individual advantages. It can be regarded as the product of choices among the people.
Only some well-known people will give up this technique at the beginning of practice and find a personal trainer to practice it in another way.
Let’s go back to the “Original Body Refining Method”.
Wang Sheng felt that this technique was indeed suitable for him.
There are no bells and whistles, and there is no so-called foundation for adapting to other techniques in the future. It is just purely improving the basic physical fitness, and doing it to the extreme.
"The original body training method is divided into five chapters: breathing, body training, pile work, body tempering, and fighting spirit."
While he was doing his exercises while standing in a stance, he was reviewing the extra memories in his mind.
"The fighting spirit needs to enter the country before it can be practiced, and the body tempering requires medicinal materials... I don't have money, so it is better to concentrate on studying the first three chapters now."
Thinking about it, he began to move slowly.
One hour later.
"Huh, after a few weeks, it seems that I am about to get started with the technique. Is this a top-grade mortal bone?"
The speed of cultivation is completely different, it is much stronger than expected by two or three times.
"Although I have not yet entered the country, my physical fitness has reached the level of a first-level warrior in the Bronze Bone Realm. What is still missing is my energy and blood."
Qi and blood, the essence, energy and spirit of a warrior are all reflected here. Huge Qi and blood is the logo and business card of a strong person.
If a person has a strong body but weak Qi and blood, he is like a patient with a hard body and feels very strange.
In short, the Qi and blood value must be increased to 1 point within three months.
Although there is still a full 0.2 distance from 1 point of health value, Wang Sheng is already confident that he will reach this level in the martial arts test three months later.
As long as we can use this to break into the first stage of the Bronze Bone Realm, Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School will have great hope.
"But it's not safe enough."
The entry isThe threshold for recommendation is correct, but it does not mean that admission is guaranteed, nor does it mean that you can be admitted as long as you take the exam.
So you have to be stronger!
